m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: My Seeing Eyes! Thank you, Wizard! Wait - what's with this Egg? Oh no! Panoptes was able use my Seeing Eyes to hatch a Wandering Eye?
Aww, it sounds cute! But I'm afraid I'd never be able to care for the little darling here. You keep it. Just promise to raise it right, OK?
Ah, there you are! There's not much time, so I'll be quick. A rogue Scholar named Panoptes has stolen my Seeing Eyes!
I fear the thief plans to use them in one of his foolhardy Pet Hatching experiments. He's already been disciplined several times for them.
Just a few days ago, he came to me asking disturbing questions about my Seeing Eyes. I sent him away, thinking the matter was done.
Later, I discover that my Office had been burgled. And guess who's nowhere to be found... Panoptes!
Please, Wizard, will you get my Seeing Eyes back before Panoptes uses them to create something we'll never be able to unsee?
Go to Aquila and get my Seeing Eyes back from Panoptes before he uses them in one of his crackpot Pet Hatching experiments!
